A Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) is a country's climate pledge under the Paris Agreement, setting out its emission-reduction targets and actions. In IAM studies, an NDC scenario models the emission pathway implied by these pledges, usually extended beyond the pledge year with assumptions about later effort. IAM results are scenario projections, not forecasts. Each scenario shows what would happen if its assumptions held (policies, technology costs, population, economic growth); it does not say how likely that future is. Comparing scenarios shows the effect of different policy choices, and comparing models on the same scenario shows how much the answer depends on model structure. Your data query is unchanged; type a change to carry on with it.
turns.title: Projections, not forecasts

turns.text: A current policies scenario assumes that only climate policies already implemented are in place and that no further policies are added. It differs from an NDC scenario, which also includes pledged but not yet implemented targets, and from a baseline, which assumes no (or no new) climate policy. turns.text: IAM PARIS (https://iamparis.eu) is an open platform that documents integrated assessment and energy-system models and publishes their results. It offers a model catalogue, study results with interactive data explorers and policy questions, data stories and an application library. Its studies come from EU research projects such as PARIS REINFORCE, IAM COMPACT, NDC ASPECTS, ENCLUDE and DECIPHER. In this chat you can ask for model descriptions, study results (for example `CO2 emissions for World in 2050`) and links to IAM PARIS pages. Your study search is unchanged; type a change to carry on with it.
turns.title: IAM PARIS
